concerns.text: FR-001 (Download/Validate dataset) is covered by T008/T108, but the spec mandates 'Download' while the plan/research clarifies the dataset is 'user-provided'. T008's description 'fetch from research.verified_datasets' contradicts the 'user-provided' constraint in spec.md (Assumptions) and research.md. A task explicitly handling the 'user-provided' file path and 'Fail Loudly' on missing file (T108) exists, but the 'Download' aspect of FR-001 is not covered by a task that aligns with the 'user-provided' reality, creating a gap in satisfying the spec's literal 'Download' requirement vs the plan's 'user-provided' reality.

FR-006 (Two-tailed t-test on permutation importance) is not covered. Tasks T024, T058, T068, T025 describe computing 'empirical p-values' via bootstrap/resampling and applying Holm-Bonferroni. While statistically robust, the spec explicitly requires a 'two-tailed t-test' (FR-006). No task explicitly implements a t-test on the permutation scores; the implementation relies on bootstrap p-values. This is a missing task for the specific FR-006 requirement.

FR-010 (Runtime ≤ 2 hours on 8-core CPU) is covered by T064, but T064 enforces the limit on a 'standard 8-core CPU' while the plan and tasks (T110) target a 'GitHub Actions runner with 2 CPU cores'. The task T064 does not explicitly address the hardware discrepancy or ensure the 2-hour limit is achievable on the actual target hardware (2 cores) as defined in the plan, creating a potential gap in satisfying the spec's hardware constraint.

Task T113 is tagged [US1] but its description 'Refactor code/models/train.py to ensure the Random Forest implementation uses n_jobs=-1' relates to model training (US2) and performance (FR-010), not data acquisition (US1). The tag is likely stale or misaligned with the task's actual scope.

Task T112 is tagged [FR-011] but its description 'Implement a validation step in code/data/preprocess.py to detect and remove duplicate rows' relates to data hygiene (FR-009) and edge cases, not 'inline code comments and README.md' (FR-011). The tag is stale/misaligned.

Task T113 (duplicate removal) and T112 (duplicate removal) both address the same FR-009 requirement. T113 is tagged [US1] and T112 is tagged [FR-011]. This redundancy and mis-tagging creates confusion about which task satisfies FR-009 and which satisfies FR-011.
